purpose: Preserve the modular batch audit trail while excluding cross-batch duplicate aliases from the frozen canonical merge.
rule: Only rows that resolve to the same physical collection, case, cabinet, set, or parent collection are superseded. Parent-child, distributed-copy, bounded-subset, and distinct-custody nodes remain separate.

same_entry_id_duplicate_batches.resolution: Collapsed automatically by prepare_survey_inputs.py entry_id de-duplication; no second canonical node.

intentional_non_duplicates: John Tomes personally prepared slides and the combined Tomes father-son collection are retained as bounded child versus parent series.
MNHN Comparative Anatomy parent and named Gervais/Schmidt subcollections are retained as parent-child nodes.
RAMM Sladen/Carpenter aggregate and W. B. Carpenter foraminifera subcorpus are retained hierarchically.
Freiberg parent thin-section collection and the 30-section Fuess set are retained hierarchically.
Bell-Pettigrew parent collection and named maker/contributor groups are retained hierarchically.
Published diatom sets at different institutions remain distinct physical copies even when serial numbers are identical.
NHM data-portal parent collections and named historical acquisitions remain separate when the latter have independent physical/provenance identity.
Heddle parent collection and the single Blarney slide are retained as collection versus item nodes.
Nicol/Forbes slides at NMS and Hooker/Nicol fossil-wood slides at BGS are separate surviving institutional holdings.
